findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation, which defaults to false, so the key material protecting the logs bucket is never automatically rotated. Long-lived key material increases the impact window if the key is ever compromised and fails common key-management baselines (CIS AWS 3.8).

No policy argument is supplied, so AWS attaches the default key policy granting kms:* to the account root, allowing any IAM principal in the account that is granted KMS permissions to use or administer the key. For a key protecting log data this provides no least-privilege separation between log producers, consumers, and key administrators.
